name: restaurant-backend
description: Shared API + real-time (SSE) server for the restaurant app. Lets the customer tab and the staff tab talk to each other.
overridesComment: express 4.22.2 is the last 4.x and pins qs 6.15.3, which carries an array-limit bypass and a DoS (GHSA-x5fp-wj9c-mxmx, GHSA-4mjr-xmp4-gh2g). 6.16.0 fixes both and is API-compatible — express's own body-parser already resolves to it. Drop this override when moving to express 5.
